reviewer.method: Sixth pass on the re-encoded sample (sha256 496226a1…, verified equal to evidence.json output_sha256; shot ranges unchanged). Targeted re-check of shot-2 and shot-3: opened all six fresh phase PNGs, built 10 fps tile sheets for both clips, traced sheet outline columns (y 345) and the hand row (y 420) in single frames of the main file at 4.40, 6.00, 7.233, 7.267, 7.30, 7.45, 7.60, 7.80, 8.00, 8.25, 8.50, 9.00 and 9.50 s, and ran a changed-pixel bounding-box scan over the first 1.3 s of the shot-3 clip to see what moves and whether the hand is on it. Re-extracted 2 fps frames from all 14 clips and diffed them against the fifth-pass frames: shots 2 and 3 changed (YAVG 2.2); shot-1 differs by 0.10 with no pixel above the 24/255 threshold (encoder noise, as in pass four); all other shots 0.00. Re-measured audio (ebur128 I=-20.4 LUFS, LRA 17.7 LU, true peak -2.0 dBFS; decoded-PCM MD5 identical to passes two to five). Entries for unchanged shots and criteria are carried forward from the fifth pass. Sound measured only, not auditioned by ear.
